reference_spans: S393: 9. The Master Equation -- the formal center
master_equation_analysis.reason: The paper references 'The Master Equation' only as a title in the Canon Reading Order (S393), identifying it as 'the formal center' of the framework. No mathematical expression, structure, or formal content of the master equation is stated, instantiated, approximated, or contradicted in this paper. The paper's own mathematical content is limited to quantitative empirical facts (E=mc^2, force ratios, cosmological constant tuning, Hubble tension) and a qualitative 24-step causal chain; none of these are presented as the master equation or as a derivation from it. Relationship cannot be assessed from the available text.

equations.plain_meaning: Mass and energy are interconvertible; the energy equivalent of a mass m is m times the square of the speed of light.

symbols.definition: energy
mass
speed of light in vacuum

equations.types_domain_codomain: m: real scalar (mass) -> E: real scalar (energy)
equations.premises_and_boundary_conditions: Special relativity; applies to massive bodies and rest energy; c is a universal constant. The paper cites it as operating for 4.6 billion years before Einstein formulated it (S357).

equations.plain_meaning: The strength of the gravitational force is approximately 10^36 times smaller than the strength of the electromagnetic force.

symbols.definition: relative coupling strength of the gravitational force
relative coupling strength of the electromagnetic force

equations.premises_and_boundary_conditions: Comparison of fundamental force coupling strengths; order-of-magnitude statement.

symbols.definition: relative coupling strength of the strong nuclear force
relative coupling strength of the electromagnetic force

equations.premises_and_boundary_conditions: Comparison of fundamental force coupling strengths; 137 approximates 1/alpha (inverse fine-structure constant) at low energy.

equations.exact_expression: cosmological constant is tuned to 1 part in 10^120
equations.plain_meaning: The observed value of the cosmological constant is fine-tuned to within one part in 10^120 of a natural theoretical value.

ratio of observed to natural value

equations.premises_and_boundary_conditions: Fine-tuning claim; depends on choice of 'natural' theoretical value (e.g., Planck-scale vacuum energy).

equations.plain_meaning: Two independent measurement methods for the universe's expansion rate disagree at the 5-sigma level of statistical significance.

symbols.definition: standard deviation of the measurement discrepancy
Hubble constant / expansion rate

equations.premises_and_boundary_conditions: Comparison of early-universe (CMB) and late-universe (distance ladder) measurements of H0.

equations.exact_expression: entropy always increases in a closed system
equations.plain_meaning: In an isolated system, the total entropy (disorder) never decreases over time.

symbols.definition: thermodynamic entropy S
a system that exchanges no matter or energy with its surroundings

equations.premises_and_boundary_conditions: Applies to isolated/closed systems; statistical statement; local decreases possible in open systems.

equations.exact_expression: God creates -> Creation stands -> What stands is distinguishable -> Distinction makes being intelligible -> What is intelligible carries information -> What carries information can stand in relation -> What can stand in relation can be kept or broken -> Therefore relation reveals value -> What has value can be regarded rightly or wrongly -> Thus value opens moral valence -> Moral valence makes right and wrong meaningful -> Right and wrong require agents who can choose -> Choice requires a world of rules, limits, time, and consequences -> Such a world permits decay, vulnerability, and loss -> Decay and vulnerability open the possibility of adversarial refusal of coherence -> The Enemy is that agency of refusal -> Adversarial action creates real debt, damage, and disorder -> Perfect Justice requires that this be truthfully answered and paid -> Perfect Mercy wills restoration rather than abandonment -> Justice and Mercy together require a cost-bearing source beyond the damaged order itself -> That source must preserve truth while making restoration possible -> That source is Grace -> Grace restores creation toward God -> Christ is the convergence point where justice, mercy, truth, and restoration meet
equations.plain_meaning: A 24-step qualitative causal chain from God's creation through distinction, information, relation, value, moral agency, choice, decay, adversarial refusal, debt, justice, mercy, grace, to Christ as the convergence point.

equations.exact_expression: 1. Necessary -- it cannot not exist, or the system collapses. 2. Self-grounding -- it cannot depend on something else (infinite regress). 3. Origin of coherence -- it must be the source of truth, order, beauty, goodness, life. 4. Active -- passive maintenance is thermodynamically impossible (the Second Law). 5. Personal -- only persons can ground moral facts (moral realism).
equations.plain_meaning: Five required properties of the source that sustains the universe: necessary, self-grounding, origin of coherence, active, personal.

equations.exact_expression: Set theory pays nine axioms. Peano arithmetic pays five. General relativity pays two postulates. This framework pays one.
